description:
Updates PHP configuration for a domain

HTTP: PATCH /v1/domains/:id/php
Category: Domains
Required scopes: domains:write
Returns: {status, data: object {php_version, memory_limit, max_execution_time, upload_max_filesize, post_max_size}}
Mutating: changes server state.

max_execution_time.description: PHP max_execution_time in seconds; unchanged when omitted or 0

php_version.description: An installed PHP version such as 8.3 (see GET /v1/php/versions); unchanged when omitted

id.description: UUID of the domain — obtain it from GET /v1/domains

name: panelica_domains_patch_v1_domains_id_php
